takeaway: Bochdalek hernias: posterolateral defects (85-90% of diaphragmatic hernias), left side in 80%. Morgagni hernias, between costal and sternal origins, are rare (1-2%).

lines.text: Where do Bochdalek hernias most often occur?
Diaphragmatic hernias come from failed fusion of its parts, or from a primary defect.
Most, 85 to 90 per cent, arise from posterolateral defects: the Bochdalek hernia.
lines.say: Most, eighty-five to ninety per cent, arise from posterolateral defects: the Bochdalek hernia.

lines.text: The left side is most commonly affected, in 80 per cent.
